科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为派出几位工程师——最好是已经驻扎在飞船上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——也许就可以使其恢复运转。
texts.en:
The orbital station appears to have once functioned as a mineral extraction and processing center for the asteroid, not wholly dissimilar from our own mining station designs.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] expects that a handful of engineers - ideally [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] already stationed on military vessels - just might be able to restore the station to working order.

label.zh: 我们对异种残骸没有兴趣。
label.en: We have no interest in xeno wreckage.

label.zh: 我们重建这个太空港吧。

texts.zh: 工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。
texts.en: The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

texts.zh:
工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。

对于这个空间站最初的功能我们仍然还有很多不了解的地方。看来这里最初用于开采和精炼某些其它的资源，而非我们所感兴趣的矿物生产。以上推测还需进一步调查才能确认。
texts.en:
The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

There remain some aspects of the station's original function that are not entirely clear to us. It appears the manufactory was originally intended to mine and refine something other than the production minerals we are interested in. This bears further investigation.

texts.zh:
工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。

我们接到报告，从工厂的加工室中回收到某种未知物质——也许这个开采站曾经开采并精炼过我们从没见过的矿物。
texts.en:
The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

We have received reports of an unknown substance recovered from the manufactory's processing chambers - it is possible that the station once mined and refined something other than the minerals we concern ourselves with.

We have received reports of an unknown substance recovered from the manufactory's processing chambers - it is possible that the station once mined and refined something other than the minerals we concern ourselves with.

label.zh: 还有很多值得研究的地方。
label.en: There is much we can learn.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]工程师们的探索一无所获。这个太空港过于破旧，已无法再次启动，很多建筑结构在尝试启动时就直接崩塌了。

在工厂坍塌的同时，有什么东西从地底下爬了出来——它们用高能激光器切开了一条通路，直勾勾地瞪着[Root.GetFleetName]。
texts.en:
The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] engineers' prodding and probing has proven fruitless. The station is too dilapidated to bring online, large sections of the structure simply collapsing under the strain of attempted reactivation.

As the manufactory's structural integrity finally failed, something, some things, emerged from its depths - cutting their way out with high-powered lasers and setting their sights on the [Root.GetFleetName].

title.zh: 古代工厂：惊动古代巢穴

texts.zh:
老旧的石层破开，有什么东西涌了出来。

完全不是预想中光洁的矿石，尖利的锯齿状晶体边缘切碎了破旧的轨道站，随后又将注意力转向了[Root.GetFleetName]。
texts.en:
As the old rock tumblers spin up, something spills out.

Far from the polished mineral ore expected, jagged crystal edges shred the decrepit orbital station before turning their attention to the [Root.GetFleetName].

texts.zh:
实际上[Root.GetName]对旧式结构体系统的狂热探查已经适得其反了。

在古老电路彻底熔断之前，[Root.GetName]设法远程启动了轨道站的变位推进器——及时的将其踢出了原有轨道，使其进入了该行星的重力井中。这次任务的不幸结果对从这一经历中成长起来的指挥官[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了深远的影响。
texts.en:
It appears as if the [Root.GetName]'s enthusiastic probing of the old construct's systems has, quite literally, backfired.

Before the ancient circuits finally fried, the [Root.GetName] managed to remotely activate the orbital station's positional thrusters - promptly knocking it out of its gentle orbit and into the star's gravity well. The mission's unfortunate outcome has had a profound impact on the ship's commander, [Root.GetLeaderName], who has grown from the experience.

texts.zh: 部署工程队伍来修复古代轨道矿场使之恢复工作状态。
texts.en: Deploy engineering teams to restore an ancient orbital station to working order.
